categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Tianma Intelligent Control Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and service of unmanned intelligent mining control technologies and equipment. Its primary product lines include the SAM comprehensive mining automation control system, SAC hydraulic support electro-hydraulic control system, SAP intelligent integrated fluid supply system, spare parts, and related professional operation and maintenance services. Additionally, the company provides intelligent manufacturing solutions for discrete manufacturing enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in unmanned intelligent mining control and high water-based hydraulic technology, supported by four major technology platforms: unmanned intelligent mining perception and control, industrial internet architecture with intrinsic safety control, high-pressure large-flow hydraulic control, and digital proportional control. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including automated, intelligent processing and assembly of high-precision components, and integrates AI, industrial Ethernet, and digital twin technologies in its products and production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large domestic coal mining enterprises and equipment manufacturers in the coal mining industry. The company serves coal mining operations requiring intelligent automation solutions for mining faces, including thin and thick coal seams, large mining heights, and top-coal caving methods. It also targets discrete manufacturing enterprises for intelligent factory upgrades and is expanding into international markets such as Australia, Russia, Poland, Turkey, and Central Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant market presence in eastern, central, northwestern, southwestern, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Inner Mongolia regions. It is actively expanding its international footprint in countries including Australia, Russia, Poland, Turkey, and Central Asia. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Beijing, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianma Intelligent Control operates primarily in the midstream segment of the coal mining equipment supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of intelligent control systems and hydraulic equipment for mining machinery. It also provides integrated solutions and after-sales services, positioning itself as a key technology and equipment supplier within the coal mining production ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth with sustained investment in R&D, focusing on breakthroughs in unmanned intelligent mining control, high water-based hydraulic technology, AI integration, digital twin, and industrial internet platforms. It aims to enhance product performance, expand into new industrial applications, and develop intelligent manufacturing capabilities. Key R&D projects include long-distance fluid supply systems, coal-rock recognition technologies, remote operation platforms, and high-pressure large-flow hydraulic pumps.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through sales of integrated unmanned intelligent mining control system solutions, core control and fluid supply equipment, spare parts sales, and operation and maintenance services. The company also earns income from providing intelligent manufacturing solutions and related equipment to discrete manufacturing enterprises. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales to end customers and equipment manufacturers, supplemented by distributor channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tianma Intelligent Control is a leading player and market share leader in China's unmanned intelligent mining control sector, holding approximately 38.5% and 38.8% market shares in hydraulic support electro-hydraulic control and comprehensive mining automation control systems respectively, and second place with 16.8% in intelligent integrated fluid supply systems. The market is characterized by a duopoly in core systems and competitive multi-player dynamics in fluid supply. The company maintains a dominant position through technological leadership and extensive customer base.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.86 billion, a 15.66% decrease year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 339.58 million, down 20.01%. Total assets grew 6.58% to RMB 5.83 billion. R&D investment accounted for 8.32% of revenue. Despite revenue decline due to market competition and coal price fluctuations, cash flow from operations increased by 38.02%, reflecting improved cash collection. The company has a solid asset base and continues to invest in innovation and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated, high-performance unmanned intelligent mining control solutions that enhance coal mining safety and efficiency by enabling remote, automated operations in hazardous environments. Its products feature deep integration of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and software technologies, supported by proprietary core technologies and extensive patents. The company offers tailored solutions for diverse mining conditions, including thin seams and complex geological scenarios, and leads in intelligent manufacturing solutions for discrete industries, differentiating itself through innovation, reliability, and comprehensive service.
